answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21961 Country: India Title: I WANT TO ASK that the Muslim can celebrate the any day in the society one cast celebrate the one type day as so 'saifi day' from the saifi biradri. so i want can the muslim celebrate this type celebrating day please describe on this matter. Question: I WANT TO ASK that the Muslim can celebrate the any day in the society one cast celebrate the one type day as so 'saifi day' from the saifi biradri. so i want can the muslim celebrate this type celebrating day please describe on this matter. Answer ID: 21961 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 708/708/M=1431) How and why does Saifi caste celebrate "Saifi Day", we do not know the detail. However, in Islam there are only two days of festivity i.e. Eidul Fitr and Eidul Azha, instead of these two days celebrating any other day is not proved. Celebrating someone's birthday is wrong as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
